title: [3.0-beta11] AAPS/NSClient Synchronisation setting has Receive APS offline events. Is it needed ?
symptom: The user found a setting 'Receive APS offline events' in AAPS app that specifies 'Accept APS offline events entered through NS or NSClient', but cannot find any way of giving 'APS offline events' (Suspend Loop, Disconnect Loop etc.) from NSClient. The user asks if the setting is unnecessary.
fix: The setting is not needed at the moment but may be needed in the future.
evidence_quote: no at the moment but maybe in the future
